info.title: fAuth API
info.description:
Multi-tenant SaaS authentication platform. EdDSA JWT signing, Argon2id password hashing, OAuth PKCE, refresh token rotation with replay detection.

**Customer-facing:** Health, Auth, OAuth, User, Management, Roles, Webhooks, Admin, Self-Serve.
**Internal (Forma-only):** Platform, Compliance.

get.description: Returns the public Ed25519 key used to verify JWT signatures.

429.description: Account locked after too many failed attempts

post.summary: Exchange authorization code or refresh token for tokens

200.description: If the email exists, a reset link has been generated

get.description: Redirects the user to the OAuth provider (Google or GitHub). Requires a registered client_id.
Receives the authorization code from the OAuth provider, exchanges it for user info, creates/updates the user, and redirects back to the client with an authorization code.

302.description: Redirect to client redirect_uri with authorization code

get.summary: Verification confirmation page. Opening the emailed link changes no state; the page POSTs the challenge.

200.description: HTML confirmation page (Cache-Control: no-store, Referrer-Policy: no-referrer)

post.summary: Consume an email verification challenge (one use, bound to tenant, user and issuance address, wall-clock expiry). No session is created.

200.description: HTML: email verified; sign in again to continue

400.description: HTML: link invalid, expired, already used, wrong tenant or address changed

get.summary: Get login history for current user

post.description: Creates a user with email/password credentials. Does NOT issue tokens — the user must login separately.

200.description: User details with roles, providers, session count

post.summary: Revoke all sessions for a user

patch.description: Update OAuth credentials, allowed providers, branding, and other settings.

get.description: Returns system roles (user, admin) plus any custom roles defined for this tenant.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped custom role with specific permissions. System role names (user, admin) are reserved.

patch.description: Update description or permissions. System roles (user, admin) cannot be modified.

delete.description: Deletes a custom role. System roles (user, admin) cannot be deleted.

post.description: Creates a webhook endpoint. The secret is returned once on creation — save it immediately.

get.description: Returns webhook details with the secret partially masked.

delete.description: Deletes the webhook and all delivery history.

get.description: Paginated delivery history for a webhook.

post.description: Dispatches a test.ping event to verify the webhook endpoint is reachable.

403.description: Feature not enabled or entitlement limit reached

get.description: Same as /manage/users but authenticated via JWT with admin role instead of mgmt_ key.

get.summary: List tenants owned by current user
get.description: Returns tenants where the authenticated user is the owner. Requires JWT auth on the platform tenant.

post.description: Creates a new tenant owned by the authenticated user. Includes a 14-day trial with 100-user limit.

post.summary: Rotate API key for owned tenant

201.description: Tenant created with management API key

get.description: Internal provider control-plane endpoint. Requires JWT with platform_owner role.

post.description: Creates an invite link for a new provider operator. Requires JWT with platform_owner role.
Revokes a pending provider operator invite. Requires JWT with platform_owner role.
Accepts an owner invite from platform login and grants platform_owner role.

get.description: Returns MFA setup and current session MFA verification state.

post.description: Generates or rotates TOTP secret and returns otpauth URI.
Verifies TOTP code and returns MFA-verified access token.

post.summary: Resend the verification email to the account's stored address. Per-account 60 s cooldown from the last issuance (including signup). 202 means the provider accepted the message, not that it was received.

202.description: status=provider_accepted; the previous link no longer works

429.description: error=resend_cooldown, or too_many_requests from the per-IP limiter

502.description: error=email_failed: provider refused or timed out; the previous link was replaced

503.description: error=email_unavailable: mail suppressed or no transport; nothing rotated or sent

TenantSlug.name: X-Tenant-Slug
TenantSlug.description: Tenant slug identifier. Alternative: use /t/{slug}/... URL path.

password.description: Must have uppercase, lowercase, digit, and not be a common password

role.description: Role name — system roles (user, admin) or any custom role name

permissions.description: Permission keys: user:read, user:write, user:delete, role:read, role:write, audit:read, config:read, config:write, webhook:read, webhook:write, or custom:* prefix

WebhookWithSecret.description: Only returned on creation — secret shown in full once.

secret.description: Full secret — save immediately, not shown again
